{{Top|leg}}
A '''bell-bot''' was a service [[Droid/Legends|droid]] employed by [[Hotel/Legends|lodging establishments]] on various [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to assist patrons with the conveyance of their luggage, from the lobby to their room. The [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] and [[FA-5 valet droid/Legends|FA-5 valet droid]] could be employed as a bell-bots.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
They are robotic versions of bellhops.
